newsitem.title: UK: Formal comments on shr fall, sees sales up.
newsitem.headline: Formal comments on shr fall, sees sales up.

text.p: British clothing firm Formal Group Plc said on Friday that it was not aware of any particular reason behind its recent share fall as it was running higher sales in the current year so far.

Formal's share price has been in negative territory in recent weeks as it touched its year's low when it opened at 35p on Friday after closing at 38.5 on Thursday. The company said low volumes could have caused the decline.

It said its sales for the current year were running 23 percent ahead of last year on a same store basis and was 47 percent up on a year-on-year basis. The company's statement on higher sales cheered some investors as its share price recovered to 47 p at 1040 gmt. Formal will announce its annual sales for the year ended September 30 by the end of November, it said.
